description: Mark npm tokens as sensitive. createToken returns the full token value (the spec: "the only time you will see the complete token"), and deleteToken's `{token}` path label can be the npm token itself (the spec: "Can be a UUID or an npm token"). The response value is Redacted on decode, and the label never becomes a span attribute. listTokens' `token` stays plain: the registry returns it already masked (`npm_aBcD...7890`).
